issues.jp_before: このボタン{を|o-object}押[お]す{と|to-conditional}、ドア{が|ga-subject}開[あ]きます。
issues.problem: Distractor なら fits grammatically after the dictionary form (押すなら) and gives a borderline-acceptable sentence.
issues.action: Replaced distractor なら with ても (押すても is ungrammatical).

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]{を|o-departure}出[で]る{と|to-conditional}、すぐ右[みぎ]{に|ni-location}銀行[ぎんこう]{が|ga-existence}ある。
issues.problem: Distractor なら is acceptable: 駅を出るなら、すぐ右に銀行がある ('if you're leaving the station, there's a bank right on the right').
issues.action: Replaced distractor なら with たら.

issues.jp_before: 冷[つめ]たい物[もの]{を|o-object}食[た]べる{と|to-conditional}、おなか{が|ga-subject}痛[いた]くなります{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: Distractor なら gives a plausible question (食べるなら、おなかが痛くなりますか).
issues.action: Replaced distractor なら with たら.

issues.jp_before: 道[みち]{を|o-path}まっすぐ行[い]く{と|to-conditional}、大[おお]きい公園[こうえん]{が|ga-existence}あります。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the この道をまっすぐ行くと question item; the English said 'this road' but the Japanese had no この.
issues.action: Replaced with 信号を渡ると、左に大きい公園があります (a different directions item).

issues.jp_before: 秋[あき]{に|ni-change}なる{と|to-conditional}、木[き]{の|no-possessive}葉[は]{が|ga-subject}赤[あか]くなります。
issues.problem: Too many 'season + になると' items (spring, winter, summer x2, autumn); not enough variety.
issues.action: Replaced with 空が暗くなると、星が見えてきます.

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]{に|ni-time}コーヒー{を|o-object}飲[の]む{と|to-conditional}、眠[ねむ]れません。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the item 朝、コーヒーを飲むと、目が覚めます.
issues.action: Replaced with 夜に甘い物を食べると、太ります.

issues.jp_before: 赤[あか]ちゃん{は|wa-topic}母[はは]{の|no-possessive}声[こえ]{を|o-object}聞[き]く{と|to-conditional}、安心[あんしん]します。
issues.problem: 母 means 'my mother' (humble, the speaker's own), which does not fit a generic baby and 'its mother'.
issues.action: Changed 母[はは] to お母[かあ]さん.

issues.jp_before: このカメラ{は|wa-topic}ここ{を|o-object}押[お]す{と|to-conditional}、写真[しゃしん]{が|potential-ga}撮[と]れます。
issues.problem: With a potential verb, 写真を撮れます is just as natural, but it was not listed as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: 友達[ともだち]{と|to-with}話[はな]す{と|to-conditional}、時間[じかん]{が|ga-subject}すぐ過[す]ぎます。
issues.problem: 時間がすぐ過ぎます is unidiomatic for 'time passes quickly'.
issues.action: Changed すぐ to 早く.
